facts.fact: 章首：又开始下雪了，毫无生命迹象，一只网球
facts.anchor: It has started to snow again. No sign of life. A tennis ball.

facts.fact: 金句：在我们在此处遇到的所有鬼魂中，我们自己的鬼魂最残忍
facts.anchor: Of all the ghosts we encounter here, the ghosts of ourselves are the cruellest.

facts.fact: 他自遇路人后首次出门，捡回路边网球放进箱子——网球线收束
facts.anchor: One morning he went outside for the first time since his attempt to walk into Lyke, and retrieved the tennis ball by the path, and put it with the rest of them.

facts.fact: ch29 的废墟（倒树、根盘、骨头）被雪收好、焕然一新
facts.anchor: The devastation he had found on his earlier visit – the fallen tree; the root plate; even the bone among the roots – everything had been tucked away, made new again by the snowfall.

facts.fact: 雪抹掉全部证据：没有脚印、没有碎茶杯、没有供品
facts.anchor: No footprints. No broken teacups. No offerings.

facts.fact: 自我认知的恐怖：也许我是供品，被召唤来满足古老神明
facts.anchor: Maybe I’m the offering. Maybe I was called here to satisfy the ancient gods.

facts.fact: 他害怕离开：如果出发后发现那里什么都没有
facts.anchor: There’s no place of that name. What if he set off and found nothing there? Nothing but that yellow mist.

facts.fact: Arthur 与 Caroline 的在场像蛤蜊填满贝壳一样填满房子
facts.anchor: The presence of Arthur and Caroline – whatever the truth of their story had been – filled it like a clam in a shell.

facts.fact: 房子低语：穿 Arthur 的衣服、住 Arthur 的房子、睡 Arthur 的床——除了 Arthur 还能是谁
facts.anchor: But in its sceptical silence, the house seemed to convey its doubt. Isn’t he? it whispered. I see a man in Arthur’s clothes. Living here in Arthur’s house. Sleeping here in Arthur’s bed. Who else but Arthur could it be?

facts.fact: 他第一次公开确认身份——声音却虚弱不确定
facts.anchor: ‘I know who I am,’ he said aloud. His voice sounded weak and uncertain.

facts.fact: 天空凶险黑暗，带着硫磺色的黄
facts.anchor: He looked up, and saw the sky baleful and dark, tinged with a sulphurous yellow.

facts.fact: 房子旁有个红色身影——他喊 Lucy
facts.anchor: There was a figure in red by the house. ‘Lucy,’ he said.

facts.fact: 走近发现不是 Lucy——是个穿红大衣的更老的女人
facts.anchor: But as he approached, he could see that it wasn’t Lucy. This was a much older woman in a red coat and a knitted hat.

facts.fact: 他喊话被无视，红衣女人以蹒跚的步态绕着房子走
facts.anchor: ‘Hey!’ he called. ‘Can I help you?’ The woman seemed not to hear him. With a curious, shambling gait, she started to walk around the house.
She’s heading for the pylon, he thought

facts.fact: 她无视他、直视电塔——双手像木槌、眼睛被倒影锁住
facts.anchor: She did not reply, but instead looked up at the pylon, hands like mallets at her side, eyes barred with reflections.

facts.fact: 他从浴室窗口看见红衣女人两次站在电塔下
facts.anchor: Several times he went upstairs and looked out of the bathroom window. Twice he saw the walker in red, standing under the pylon.
